verdict.rationale: Mixpanel exposes strong APIs (Query, Raw Export, Engage, Feature Flags, JQL) and a hosted MCP server letting AI assistants query events, funnels, retention, and even create dashboards via natural language, showing real API-first ambition. However, some UI-only features are explicitly documented as UI-managed (e.g., Session Replay sampling controls) and MCP dashboard creation is limited to 'text cards and reports,' not full UI parity, and no public OpenAPI spec was found (probe 404s), suggesting incomplete or non-standardized API coverage.
